description: Creates an empty analysis project with a name and optionally the research question and context that guide the coding, and the output language of category names. Next step: open_end_add_responses. Creates nothing billable. Requires OAuth or an API key with projects:write.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (e.g. a UUID). Repeating the call with the same key and arguments returns the original result instead of writing again. Without it, identical calls within about 10 minutes are deduplicated.

output_language.description: Language code for category names, e.g. 'en', 'cs', 'de'. Defaults to the responses' language.

research_question.description: The survey question the responses answer.

name: open_end_create_project
title: Create an analysis project
